info.title: Plinth API
info.description: Non-custodial multi-chain USDC payment gateway. Amounts are decimal strings in USDC (`"12.50"`) with exact integer base-unit twins (`*_units`). Test keys (`sk_test_`) operate on testnets; live keys (`sk_live_`) on mainnets.

200.description: A session token. The identity token is verified against Web3Auth's published keys for this deployment's client id.

post.description: Returns the hosted checkout URL and, per network, a unique counterfactual USDC deposit address. Use `Idempotency-Key` to make retries safe.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe: the first response is stored and replayed.

expires_in_seconds.description: Seconds the payment stays payable (300 to 2592000). Omit to use the merchant's default expiry, which is 1200 (20 minutes) unless changed in settings.

x-webhooks.signature: Plinth-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, `${t}.${rawBody}`)>; reject if |now - t| > 300s
x-webhooks.retries: 8 attempts over ~10 hours with exponential back-off; every attempt is logged. Handlers must be idempotent (dedupe on event.id).
